text.tspan: A complete inference stack: three layers that work together
TOOLING: how engineers work with the stack
enough control to tune things, without losing productivity
RUNTIME: make one model fast on one GPU-backed instance
the deep-learning framework: the model's code and maths
NVIDIA's platform for running code on GPUs
INFRASTRUCTURE: scale across clusters, regions and clouds
send each request to the right replica
add or remove GPU replicas as traffic goes up and down
find and use GPUs across clouds and regions, with no silos
the hardware that runs the model
Runtime makes ONE copy of the model fast · Infrastructure runs MANY copies reliably
Tooling lets engineers use both · weak in any one layer = weak inference
